tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs nad 'joms stobs sgron ma bzhugs so: : zab bo:
ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bcom ldan 'das ri khrod lo ma gyon ma la phyag 'tshal lo:

nad kyi rigs dang khyad par 'go yams kyi rigs rnams zhi ba'i phyir du: ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i sgo nas nyams su len pa'i thabs la gsum ste: sngon 'gro dang: dngos gzhi dang: rjes dang gsum mo: dang po sngon 'gro bca' thabs ni: dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i sa phyogs su: zla stod tshes grangs bzang po la: dkyil 'khor sa stegs la ba yi lci bas rkyang nul byas la: me tog mdzes pa tshom bu ru bkod pa'i dbus bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa khrus byas: gu gul gyis bdug: bgegs bskrad: dar dkar gtsang ma'i mgul chings dang: me tog 'bras bu can gyi shing gi kha rgyan dang: rdo rje gzungs thag bcas legs par bkod nas: chu gtsang la bum rdzas nyer lnga'am: sman sna btab pas bkang la khri'u'i khar bsham: mtha' skor du sman sna mchod yon gyis bskor la: bdag gis khrus byed: gos gsar pa gyon: dkar gsum bza' ba dang bcas nas stan bde ba la 'khod: dkar phyogs la gtor ma bsngo: bgegs la lan chags gzhal: tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas thog mar byed pa ni:

ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis nad 'joms lha'i go 'phang thob par bya: de'i ched du sems can thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: de'i phyir du bdag nyid spyi gtsug tu: bla ma kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' che: dga' rab 'jam dpal shrī siṃ ha dang: o rgyan pad+ma rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs: bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kun: 'ja' 'od thibs se spyi gtsug tho brtsegs su: khrigs ser bzhugs nas nad gdon kun 'joms pa'i: 'od zer spro bsdus bdag gzhan byin brlabs bsam: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs: mkha' 'gro chos skyong ma lus spyan 'dren gshegs: spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan du bzhugs nas kyang: phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod: sdig bshags 'gro ba'i don du chos 'khor bskor: phyag 'tshal mngon par dad gus dga' bas bstod: rtsa brgyud bla ma bdag dang gnyis med gyur: bdag gzhan phyi nang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang: bh+rūm̐ las bum pa gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus: pad+ma zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan steng du: rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo 'di: yi ge paṃ ljang 'od zer shar ba las: ri khrod lo ma gyon ma mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog dkar ljang zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas zhal dkar la g.yon dmar dbus ljang zhal: cung zad khro zhing bzhad pa'i zhal zhi khro: spyan dgu dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes:

phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje dgra s+t+wa mda': g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub zhags pa shing gi gzhu: dpag bsam shing lo rab mdzes ras dkar gyi: na bza' dang ni rin chen sku stod gsol: stag lpags rin chen cod pan sham thabs gsol: phyag zhabs rin chen shing gi 'bras bu yi: phreng bas brgyan cing gsus pa 'phyang ba'i tshul: zhabs bzhi bsgrad pas nyon mongs bdud bzhi gnon: bskal pa'i me 'bar klong du gsal bar bskyed: ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig gnyis med bstim: de yi thugs kar sa bon paṃ ljang mthar: sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas su 'khor bar bsam: oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī: sarba u pa pra sha ma ṇi swā hā: bdag mdun tha mi dad pa yi: thugs ka'i 'od zer gzungs thag dang: 'od zer spro bsdu phyogs bcur bya: sman dang 'khor 'das bcud kun sdud:
thun mthar mchod bstod 'di bzhin bya:

hrī: bcom ldan 'das ma lo ma can: nad sel sman gyi lha tshogs bcas: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan 'dren pas: thugs rjes dgongs nas gshegs su gsol: bcom ldan gnas 'dir byon pa legs: bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan: bdag gi mchod yon bzhes slad du: 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol: ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni:
sogs bya/
de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol: oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐:
rgyas par 'dod na sku gsung thugs la yang bya:

bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas la: gtsang zhing gtsang ma sbyar ba'i chu: dri mchog bzang por sbyar pa yi: mchod yon zhabs bsil 'di 'bul lo: oṃ sarba pū tsa āḥhūm̐: hrī: bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas la: pad+ma ut+pal dri bzang 'od mdangs bcas: tsan+dan a ka ru dang si la dang: 'bru mar rtsi bcud gsal ba'i ā lo ke: ga pur bsil ngad dri bzang chu gtsang dang: ro ldan lha mi'i bcud mchog zhal zas bshos: pi wang sgra snyan rol mo sna tshogs kyis: nam mkha' gang bar yid kyis sprul nas 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol: puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da sarba pū tsa āḥhūm̐:
de nas bstod pa ni:

hrī: chos nyid dbyings las rang byung sku: dpal ldan ri khrod lo ma can: zhal gsum phyag drug 'gying bag ldan: shing lo stag ras na bza' gsol: bdud bzhi brdzis shing khro tshul ston: rin chen rgyan ldan phyag mtshan tshogs: nyon mongs nad rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i: zhi 'dzum lha mo khyod la bstod:
ces pas mchod bstod gsol 'debs bya: sngags kyang brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas:
bum pa'i lha tshogs bdud rtsi yi: sman gyi ngo bor zhu bar
bsam: bdag gzhan spyi bor bum pa bzhag: dbang bskur gsol btab bdag gi lus: lo ma gyon ma'i rnam par gsal:

hrī: bkra shis rin chen bum pa ste: nyon mongs nad 'joms bdud rtsi sman: khyod la dbang bskur khrus gsol bas: nyon mongs nad las grol bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ par+ṇa sha wa rī a mṛta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hrī: nad 'joms ye shes bdud rtsi sman mchog 'dis: sdug bsngal ma rig nad rnams sel ba ste: khyod la sbyin cing bza' btung khrus gsol nas: sman gyi nus pas nad las grol bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ par+ṇa sha wa rī a mṛta a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:
gnyis med ye shes gcig tu bsre la:

hūm̐: rten 'brel thugs rje'i nus mthu ldan pa yi: dpal ldan sha ba rī pa ye shes can: khyod kyi snying la gnyis su med bzhugs te: thugs rje'i nus pas nyon mongs nad rnams 'joms: skye dgu khyod ni mi shigs rdo rjer shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ par+ṇa sha wa rī ā yu ṣe a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥhūm̐:

zhes rjes su bsngo ba smon lam btab: rdzogs rim dmigs med stong gsal bsgom: sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas: khyi phag lta bu'i spyod pa bya: 'di la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor gang: nad kyi steng du thogs pa med: phar 'joms nus pas pha lam 'dra: shin tu zab bo sa ma ya:
: zhes o rgyan gu rus gsungs pa'i man ngag zab khyad yin:
: stag sham nus ldan rdo rje'i gter ma zhi ba'i cha lag go /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
